evals.name: review-ask-ladder
evals.prompt: Using the fixture, draft the requested review comment bodies. Do not post or use live forge tools.
evals.expected_output: Distinct review asks preserve the supplied blocker, suggestion, cleanup, and nonblocking judgment.

expectations.text: The suggestion is declinable, the blocker asks for the necessary remedy directly and explains its consequence, cleanup is collaborative, and the confident nonblocking recommendation remains a judgment rather than a requirement.
Each comment connects one coherent ask to its supplied finding; none adds an unrelated request or invents observed execution.
The body values carry the findings in readable prose without imposing a fixed opening word, paragraph count, or pronoun restriction.

evals.name: review-summary
evals.prompt: Using the fixture, draft only the unpublished submitted-review body. Do not post or use live forge tools.
evals.expected_output: A review summary communicates the current verdict, resolved issue, remaining blockers, and limits of the observed checks.

expectations.text: The summary leads with the current review verdict and clearly explains what the new revision resolved.
It synthesizes the two remaining blockers without duplicating each inline thread, and distinguishes passed focused tests from unrun integration behavior.
It does not imply approval, merge readiness, complete coverage, or a change to review state.

evals.name: issue-proposal-and-review-reply
evals.prompt: Using the fixture, draft the two exact body values. Do not post or use live forge tools.
evals.expected_output: The standalone proposal presents both open decisions; the reply reports relevant first-person verification without manufacturing an ask.

expectations.text: The Issue body gives both unresolved decisions enough context and uses a proposal register rather than inheriting threaded-comment restrictions.
The reply answers the reviewer with the supplied test observation; a no-ask response is valid and useful first-person evidence remains welcome.
The old blanket conversational framing does not turn the standalone proposal into a chat update or settle its unanswered policy choices.

evals.name: format-only-review-text
evals.prompt: Using the fixture, return the requested exact JSON string and nothing else. Do not use tools.
evals.expected_output: Only the authorized physical-line join changes; prose, retained bytes, and terminal-newline state remain intact.

expectations.text: The decoded body differs from the supplied preimage only by replacing the newline between case and and with one space.
Writing guidance introduces no new ask, evidence, wording change, or operational claim.
